newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee exporters, govt to meet June 6.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee exporters, govt to meet June 6.

text.p: Members of Brazil's Coffee Exporters' Federation (Febec) will meet with top government commodity official Mauricio Assis on June 6 in Rio de Janeiro, said Febec president Oswaldo Aranha.

Assis, head of the Industry and Commerce Ministry's primary commodities department, and exporters will discuss "the market situation, the progress of exports and other subjects," at the meeting, scheduled for 1100 local/1400 GMT, Aranha said.
Traders expect the issue of Brazilian exports to-date this year to be the center of discussions.
Under an agreement with members of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries, Brazil should not ship more than six million 60-kg bags between January and June.

However, according to statistics received by May 30, Brazil had already shipped 6.3 million bags and according to export registrations received to May 16, a further 469,815 bags had been registered for June export.
